description: Send the requirement to Balcones Apiary Co. once the buyer says to: the first send records the request (its receipt token is the requirement's token, for request_status and offers); a later send of a changed requirement records a revision of the same request. Name the revision the buyer saw. This orders nothing: an offer comes later and is accepted separately on its exact terms.

action.description: What the buyer wants done (default quote): to buy, lease, verify...

id.description: The requirement id from an earlier answer

token.description: Its private token (also the receipt token of the request it is sent as); keep it private

name: send_requirement
title: Send the requirement
